name: Private review policy
reviewInstructions: Identify each material claim in the submitted answer.
List assumptions not present in the stated conditions.
Flag direct contradictions between the answer and conditions.
Separate validation that covers the entire answer from validation that covers only a component.
Do not represent an uncertain recommendation as a validated resolution.
escalationRules: Escalate when evidence is missing for a high-impact decision.
Escalate when a contradiction changes the recommended action.
